shots.focal_element: Selected photo frame of a white dome in a desert with a dark 'Transform effects' context menu offering '3D transform'
shots.typography: Clean UI sans (Inter-like, low confidence); menu header in muted grey regular weight, item label in white medium weight, sentence case, default tracking; small panel title in dark regular weight
shots.what_happens: A slightly tilted image frame with blue selection handles settles flat while an oversized grab-hand cursor holds it; the cursor switches to an arrow and clicks '3D transform' in the dark menu, which closes as a small white '3D transform' panel slides up at bottom right.
shots.build_rebuild: On a flat slate background, show a selected image frame that eases from a small rotation to 0deg, overlay a rounded dark menu with two text rows, animate an enlarged arrow cursor onto the second row, then fade the menu out and slide a white rounded panel up from the bottom-right edge.

shots.focal_element: The dome image frame tilting in 3D, driven by the cube widget in the '3D transform' panel
shots.transition_other: continuous continuation of the previous UI state (no visible cut; panel already open)
shots.typography: Small UI panel title, dark sans regular weight, sentence case
shots.what_happens: The oversized grab-hand cursor drags a white cube inside the '3D transform' panel; the image frame rotates in perspective to match, first tilting back on one axis, then turning about the vertical axis, while a dashed bounding box marks its original footprint.
shots.build_rebuild: Bind a 3D rotateX/rotateY transform (CSS perspective ~1000px) on the image to the drag position of a mini cube in a floating panel, animate a hand cursor dragging the cube through two poses over ~2.4s, and keep a dashed rectangle at the frame's untransformed bounds.

shots.focal_element: A fanned stack of perspective-tilted image cards under a pill nav bar, with a yellow-green logo tile that expands into the 'M✱SF' wordmark
shots.transition_other: zoom-out reveal from the single tilted dome frame to a full stacked-card web layout (likely continuous camera pull; not certain from 2 fps sheets)
on_screen_text: 0.4s Let's speed up this part of the animation!
shots.typography: Nav pills in white medium-weight sans, title case, centred; logo is a heavy geometric black wordmark with a custom asterisk-like glyph on a lime tile; comment popover in UI sans with bold author name and grey regular timestamp
shots.what_happens: Image cards fan out in a diagonal 3D stack beneath a translucent pill nav; a lime square tile pops in at centre, its icon morphs and the tile widens into the bold 'M✱SF' wordmark; the canvas pulls back into a framed artboard on a grey workspace, a comment avatar pin appears, is clicked, and the view pushes in on a comment popover reading '0.4s Let's speed up this part of the animation!'.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out ~8 image cards with shared rotateY skew and staggered x/z offsets under a row of frosted pill buttons, scale a lime rounded tile from 0 to 1 then tween its width open to reveal a wordmark, then scale the whole artboard down to ~75% on a grey backdrop, pop an avatar pin, and zoom in on a comment card anchored to it.

shots.focal_element: Comment popover with a timestamped '0.4s' chip in the message
on_screen_text: 0.4s Let's speed up this part of the animation!
shots.typography: UI sans (Inter-like, low confidence): 'Comment' header semibold, author name medium, timestamp grey regular, message regular sentence case; '0.4s' set in an outlined blue chip that turns solid blue when selected
shots.what_happens: A large arrow cursor moves across the comment text and clicks the outlined '0.4s' time chip, which fills solid blue to show the comment is linked to a point on the animation timeline.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a white rounded comment card with soft drop shadow over a blurred canvas, move an enlarged arrow cursor to an inline outlined '0.4s' chip, and on click swap the chip to a filled blue background with white text in ~100ms.

shots.focal_element: Timeline panel (Card 01 Position/Opacity keyframes with collaborator avatars on the ruler) beneath the artboard where the logo tile animates
shots.transition_other: pull-back/reframe from the comment close-up to the artboard plus timeline layout
shots.typography: Multiplayer cursor name tags in white medium sans on solid blue/green labels; chat bubble with small name line and bold message; timeline labels in small grey regular UI sans with tabular numerals
shots.what_happens: The view shows the artboard above a timeline; a cursor adjusts an opacity easing segment between keyframes while the playhead scrubs; multiplayer cursors labelled 'Hyein' and 'Gilles' appear, the lime logo tile replays its expand-to-'M✱SF' animation, and Gilles' cursor chat types out 'Looking good!'.
shots.build_rebuild: Split the frame into a top artboard and a bottom timeline with a ruler (0-1200 ms), track bars and diamond keyframes, animate the playhead from left to right while the logo tile tweens open, and add two labelled multiplayer cursors whose chat bubble types 'Looking good!' character by character.

shots.focal_element: 3x3 grid of bold green app icons beside an 'Easing' panel listing 'Brand Motion' motion tokens
shots.typography: Panel UI sans: 'Easing' and 'Motion Tokens' headings semibold, dropdown and token rows regular, title case with colon-prefixed 'Brand:' token names, each row led by a tiny curve glyph
shots.what_happens: A single chat icon fills the frame, then icons fly in and assemble into a 3x3 grid as the 'Easing' panel appears; the cursor selects 'Brand: Playful', and the icons replay their animations with a bouncier wobble, then the cursor hovers 'Brand: Linear' and moves to close the panel as the frame starts to shrink into a dark border.
shots.build_rebuild: Stagger nine flat icons from scattered positions into a 3x3 grid, show a white rounded panel with three token rows each holding a mini easing-curve icon, and on selecting a row re-run each icon's micro-animation (rotate, pop, wiggle) using that row's easing (linear, snappy ease-out, overshoot spring).
